associations.name: Checkrun schema association policy
associations.note: Dotfiles owns this policy instance; checkrun owns the schema that defines the policy document shape.

associations.name: Sley verify registry
associations.note: Sley owns this schema as dependency public API; resolve it through shdeps instead of duplicating the payload under dotfiles.

associations.note: grafhome-ca owns the policy format and its schema as one public contract.

associations.name: Grafhome CA legacy user remotes policy
associations.note: grafhome-ca owns the policy format and its schema as one public contract.

associations.name: lazygit config
associations.note: Track the XDG lazygit config path because the shared config is intentionally platform-neutral.

associations.name: Biome fallback config
associations.note: Biome uses one config file for both formatting and linting, so validate the shared fallback policy.

associations.name: mise global config
associations.note: mise owns the global tool bootstrap set, so schema validation catches drift before dot update relies on it.

associations.name: bottom config
associations.note: bottom's config is tracked directly under XDG config, not generated by a merge hook.

associations.name: Gitleaks config
associations.note: Gitleaks has a SchemaStore schema for its TOML config.

associations.name: Claude Code settings layers
associations.note: Merge-hook source layers are valid Claude settings documents before they are merged into the generated destination config.

associations.name: Gemini CLI settings layers
associations.note: Merge-hook source layers are valid Gemini settings documents before they are merged into the generated destination config.

associations.name: VS Code settings layers
associations.note: Merge-hook source layers and tracked workspace settings are valid VS Code settings; keep this editor-only because VS Code owns the dynamic extension-aware settings schema.

associations.name: VS Code keybindings layers
associations.note: Merge-hook JSONC keybinding layers are merged into keybindings.json; keep this editor-only because VS Code owns the keybinding schema.

associations.name: VS Code extension manifest fragments
associations.note: Each file is a merge-hook source fragment; profiles may be incomplete until the sorted fragment set is aggregated by the VS Code helper.

associations.name: Docker Compose config
associations.note: Compose files are common repo-local YAML configs; validate the convention names before considering noisier general YAML lint.

associations.name: Dependabot v2 config
associations.note: Dependabot's schema gives targeted validation for the standard GitHub config path.

associations.name: GitHub workflow
associations.note: GitHub workflow YAML has a focused SchemaStore schema for editor help; keep advisory because PyYAML treats the key 'on' as a boolean while actionlint and zizmor provide native validation.

associations.name: Renovate config
associations.note: Renovate publishes its own schema; keep JSON/JSONC-like config validation targeted to supported JSON paths here.

associations.name: pre-commit config
associations.note: pre-commit config has a focused schema, so it should not rely on generic YAML checks for signal.

associations.name: Cargo manifest
associations.note: Cargo.toml is the standard Rust project manifest and benefits from schema validation before tool-specific lint runs.

associations.name: PyProject config
associations.note: pyproject.toml multiplexes many Python tools; validate the shared container shape in addition to tool-specific fallback configs.

associations.name: tox config
associations.note: tox.toml is a project-local Python test config, separate from the Checkrun fallback configs.

associations.name: uv config
associations.note: uv has a dedicated project config schema for standalone uv.toml files.

associations.name: package manifest
associations.note: package.json is a standard manifest; the generic match covers tracked local extension manifests without dotfiles-specific paths.

associations.name: Hatch config
associations.note: Hatch project config has its own schema and should not be validated only as generic TOML.

associations.name: Cargo Make config
associations.note: cargo-make conventionally uses Makefile.toml, which is a project config rather than a Checkrun Makefile lint target.

associations.name: cargo-nextest repository config
associations.note: nextest repository config is project-local test policy and has a first-party schema.

associations.name: golangci-lint fallback config
associations.note: This is autolint's global fallback config, so it is not always named like a project-local golangci-lint config.

associations.name: RuboCop fallback config
associations.note: This is autolint's global fallback config, so it is associated by dotfiles path rather than relying on project-local names.

associations.name: Hadolint fallback config
associations.note: This is autolint's global fallback config, so it is associated by dotfiles path rather than relying on project-local names.

associations.name: Ruff fallback config
associations.note: Ruff shares formatter and linter options in one fallback config.

associations.name: rustfmt fallback config
associations.note: This is autoformat's global fallback config, so it is associated by dotfiles path rather than relying on project-local names.

associations.name: StyLua fallback config
associations.note: This is autoformat's global fallback config, so it is associated by dotfiles path rather than relying on project-local names.

associations.name: Taplo fallback config
associations.note: Taplo shares formatter and linter options in one fallback config.

associations.name: typos fallback config
associations.note: This is autolint's global fallback config, so it is associated by dotfiles path rather than relying on project-local names.

associations.name: rumdl fallback config
associations.note: rumdl shares markdown formatting and lint policy in one fallback config.

associations.name: yamlfmt fallback config
associations.note: The standard .yamlfmt name and dotfiles fallback names all use the same published schema.

associations.name: Codex config layers
associations.note: Kept advisory because the current source layer uses sandbox_workspace_write, which is not accepted by the published Codex schema yet.
